claim: Depth of field. Shallow focus separates a subject from the world; deep focus keeps the world present and pressing in.
look_at: shallow separates; deep/medium interchangeable; rack cannot exist in a still.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes

panels.clause: deep focus, everything sharp, background in focus
shallow depth of field, bokeh, blurred background
selective focus, foreground sharp, background heavily blurred
